speaker: john_heminges
text: Navarre is off. I am not setting a figure on a thin yard, and I will not borrow one.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I added nothing. When the yard gives me nothing, I speak what is set down, and I stop.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then I have no new tick. The margin stands where it stood. Nineteen lines, and a noise like a goose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it standing. I have nothing to add to a blank, and nothing to add to that tally.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You, and your blank. I walked on, and I came off, and the jig was the jig.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Old comedy. Thin house. No number beside it. I will write that.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And I will not write a line you did not speak, Master Kemp.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done. God give you the road down. I am walking it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: We are walking it with you. That is as far as my charity goes tonight.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Go. The flag was up. The house was thin. That is the afternoon I am willing to enter.
